title: PAC-Wrap: Semi-Supervised PAC Anomaly Detection

problem.claim: Safety-critical applications need anomaly detection that prevents hazardous outcomes.

gap.claim: Semi-supervised anomaly detection needs provable bounds on false negative and false positive detection rates.

contributions.claim: PAC-Wrap provides Probably Approximately Correct guarantees on false negative and false positive detection rates in the semi-supervised setting.
PAC-Wrap wraps around virtually any existing semi-supervised or unsupervised anomaly detection method to provide rigorous guarantees.

author_reported_evidence.claim: Experiments across various anomaly detectors and datasets suggest that PAC-Wrap is effective broadly.

narrative_sequence.summary: Anomaly detection is important for preventing hazardous outcomes in safety-critical applications.
Safety-critical use cases benefit from provable error bounds.
The paper proposes PAC guarantees for false negative and false positive detection rates and implements them through PAC-Wrap.
Experiments across anomaly detectors and datasets indicate broad effectiveness.

unknowns: Exact PAC bounds and their assumptions are unspecified.
The anomaly detectors, datasets, metrics, and quantitative results are unspecified.
The method's computational cost and limitations are unspecified.
